paragraphs.text: Konstrari is the School of Constructive Arts at Hexhaven Academy on the Echoverse version of Arcavios . It is aligned and the counterpart of Prismari . The founder of the school is Aerid Konstrari .
Aerid Konstrari founded Konstrari with three guiding tenets:
Embrace the heart (bravery) and trust the soul (insight).

Konstrari mages channel creativity and artistic inspiration into the construction of buildings, constructs, and puppet soldiers for Jace's grand project. The school is not focused on changing the plane, but rather surviving in it. Courses in natural fabrication teach complex joinery spells to lash together natural materials. Physical training is an integral part of their education. Konstrari cadets are architects, builders, sculptors, and designers. Graduates gravitate toward vocations as architects and engineers. Anima schematics—studies of creature anatomy—form the basis of all Konstrari structural designs. Mages who specialize in these schematics are known as "diagramancers".

Konstrari constructs are a form of self-expression designed to defend Echoverse Arcavios. Puppetbeasts are made from wood, stone, and clay and embellished with metal and fabric. Larger constructs are built by teams of designers and builders, including the tethermage who serves as the primary pilot. Highly skilled tethermages can pilot a construct from a great distance, but most ride them. Tethermage training courses can only be pursued after a cadet has siphoned their first heartwood , spun from the mage's lifeforce and natural materials and used to animate and tether a puppetbeast to its pilot. Most cadets house the heartwood in a small container that hangs from their belt. The most advanced Konstrari mages can create a heartwood crystal directly out of leyline energy.

The Prototype Den contains a small library of past construct designs to inspire students. Marlmaze Formation is a series of workshop spaces that house in-progress constructs. From there, one can follow the suspended walkways to the Puppetport , a massive hall that houses a vast array of inactive constructs. The raw materials used by Konstrari come from Esker Hollow , where a river has cut a small ravine along the base of a cliff. Sturdy, fast-growing trees planted by Vigorbloom propagators line the riverbank next to a wall of natural stone.
